hotspots.title: Trump Midterm Rallies & Campaign Trail Violence
hotspots.blurb: Donald Trump campaigns aggressively across key states like Florida and Iowa ahead of the midterms, while facing a storm of criticism over his rhetoric, administrative policies, and escalating political tensions.
hotspots.affect: High-octane campaign mobilization meets intense partisan friction, driving fierce affective polarization across multiple fronts.
